decisions.decision: Dual-native architecture with separate Android Compose and iOS SwiftUI codebases sharing a pure KMP domain core
iOS minimum deployment target locked at iOS 17.0+ (Swift 5.9+ / Swift 6.0 Concurrency)
Android minSdk provisionally locked at 26 (Android 8.0 Oreo), compileSdk 35, targetSdk 35
KMP scope strictly bounded to Option C: small deterministic domain core (geo, first-mile, timetables, provenance)
Mapping SDK strategy locked at Option 2: Google Maps Compose on Android, Apple MapKit (SwiftUI.Map) on iOS
Turn-by-turn navigation handoff strategy: zero-cost external deep link to native Google Maps / Apple Maps ($0.00 cost)
Liquid Glass policy: Progressive enhancement on supported Apple hardware; baseline is standard high-contrast system materials on iOS 17. Never fake in software
Figma MCP integration: Official remote streamable HTTP server configured at https://mcp.figma.com/mcp
Figma workspace structure established: 00 Foundations, 01 Shared Semantics, 10-15 Android, 20-25 iOS, 90 Stitch, 99 Archive
Stitch MCP role: Concept exploration, mood alternatives, and layout ideas only; Stitch code is NEVER committed to production
Figma Code Connect: Decision deferred to REVIEW_AT_M5 when production components are scaffolded
Repository structure: Retain mobile/ Gradle root with future mobile/android/ and mobile/shared/; decoupled mobile/ios/ Xcode project
M0.5 app scaffolding prohibition: Zero production screens, zero app scaffold, zero Xcode project, zero build files in mobile/android during M0.5. Bootstrap at M5
Execution sequence: Parallel Android and iOS execution across M0 to M30; neither platform serves as template for the other
Design philosophy: Capability, truth, contract, and quality parity mandatory; visual, motion, and navigation presentation divergence explicitly allowed
API contract strategy: Native Retrofit/OkHttp on Android, native URLSession on iOS; zero networking code in KMP
Truth contract: Transit candidate stops cannot participate in exact walking guidance; scheduled timetable bus departures labeled 'Scheduled', never 'Live'; photo count = distinct source assets
Ponytail governance: Standard library over third-party dependencies, native platform capabilities over abstractions
